skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA026
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA026. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.quote: There's no end to the race with the reaper; you've always got to take a proper break.

skins.name: Travel Freely
skins.content: Cambrian 1100 Winter New Arrivals/Travel Freely. A red and white baseball jacket over a black hoodie, paired with drawstring pants and sports shoes. Comfy and casual, unrestrictive and lightweight, suited for day-to-day travel.
skins.quote: The palm tree sticker was given to her by a surf shop owner during her last trip to Siesta, and the Lupo sticker is from her trip before that to Columbia, where an arcade manager awarded it for a new high score. Both adorn her suitcase. Who knows what she can get on her next trip?
